title: Fail-loud fixes for pr_scope detector review findings
intent: Close the request-changes items on PR #20: malformed manifests must not be silently normalized or crash run(), and rename parsing must authorize the destination path explicitly.

scope.out_of_scope_notes: Does not change other analyzers, OpenAPI, or i18n. Lands on the PR #20 branch rather than replacing it.

what_changed: Reject duplicate changed_files_exact and declared-scope entries, including collisions after ./ normalization.
Validate head_sha and present-but-falsy base_sha as non-empty strings so malformed pins are CRITICAL findings, never exceptions.
Parse git diff --name-status -z and authorize only the rename/copy destination path.
Fail loud on unsafe observed git paths and non-UTF-8 git output instead of dropping or replacing bytes.
Attribute coverage-percent parse errors to the field that failed; clarify file_context_coverage-only summary wording.
Honour scan_project(..., pr_scope_manifest=) even when a custom analyzer list is supplied.
Split PrScopeAnalyzer.run() into load/validate/resolve/diff/reconcile helpers; bump analyzer 2.0.0 -> 2.1.0.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: PR #20 already ships the detector; this patch only closes the remaining fail-loud and rename-parsing defects that would make the gate untrustworthy.

test_results: version bump enforcement passed on Python 3.11 after logic_manifest refresh
verification.notes: logic_manifest.json refreshed on Python 3.11. Full pytest suite not re-run; targeted to pr_scope plus the version-bump gate.
